Next 7 days

    Season map

    Each square is a day: green = board slots done, red = missed, outlined red = exam. Tap a square to open that day.

    Phases

    7 Nov – 31 Dec: one full pass of all subjects, plus 60 min of NEET (Class 11) on school days.
    1 Jan – 13 Feb: second pass, practicals, Physics papers.
    14 Feb – 25 Mar: exam run, ending with a 19-day Biology sprint.
    26 Mar – 1 May: NEET sprint with weekly mocks, CUET alongside.
    2 – 10 May: NEET day, then the CUET push.

    Read before using
    • * = not announced. NEET UG 2027 is expected on 2 May and CUET UG in May. Shift the last two phases once NTA publishes its bulletins.
    • Boards come first. Drop the NEET and CUET lines on a heavy day, never the board slots.
    • NEET covers Class 11 and 12; chapters CBSE removed (such as Solid State, p-Block) may still be in it.
    • Full topic lists are in the boards revision doc.

    Revise

    Ticking a study slot schedules quick recalls after 1, 3, 7 and 21 days. Spend 5 to 10 minutes on each: close the book and write what you remember.
